visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page hero with a full-bleed photo, dark overlay and centered H1, italic subline and CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-viewport-width photo with a dark overlay and large centered H1, italic subline and button. Reusable for the destination hero (section.amalfi-hero).

contentPattern.structure: row 1 (optional): background image; row 2: H1 headline, subline paragraph, CTA link
contentPattern.description: Full-bleed background photo with overlaid headline, subline and CTA: a hero. The photo background belongs to the block.

usage.description: First section of the homepage and destination pages (amalfi-hero).

reuseGuidance: Use for any full-bleed photo hero with light text over a dark overlay. For a short pale-washed closing banner use hero-cta-banner.

cells: Eyebrow paragraph (optional), Title heading (H1 for top hero, H2 for closing), subheading paragraph, CTA link (buttons have no href in source; use link), optional note paragraph
